content: For deleting indexed pages: 404 is crawled far more often than 410 and lingers in the index longer; 410 signals permanent intentional removal and de-indexes faster. Use 301 redirect only when there is a genuinely relevant successor page or the page has valuable backlinks (preserves link equity); otherwise 404/410 is correct. Monitor removal via Google Search Console URL Inspection and Page Indexing reports, and request removal/resubmit sitemap.
